He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Maryland Terrapins men's basketball|Maryland Terrapins]]. ==Early life and high school career== Smith was born in [[Portsmouth, Virginia]] to Charles and Orletha Smith and his one sibling Kiara Smith.{{cite web |title=USA Basketball Bio |url=https://www.usab.com/basketball/players/mens/s/smith-jalen.aspx |website=usab.com |publisher=USA Basketball |accessdate=August 25, 2018}} Smith attended [[Mount Saint Joseph High School]] in [[Baltimore|Baltimore, Maryland]] where he averaged 22.2 points, 12.0 rebounds, and 4.0 blocks per game as a senior and won several awards, among them, the Gatorade Maryland Boys Basketball Player of the Year twice.{{cite web |last1=Cann |first1=Harrison |title=Jalen Smith made Terps fans excited about the future at the McDonald’s All-American Game |url=http://www.dbknews.com/2018/03/30/jalen-smith-basketball-recruiting-mcdonalds-all-american-game/ |publisher=[[The Diamondback]] |accessdate=August 25, 2018 |date=March 30, 2018}} He was named to the [[2018 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|2018 McDonald's All-American]] team.{{cite web |last1=Borzello |first1=Jeff |title=Top players named to McDonald's All-American teams |url=http://www.espn.com/recruiting/basketball/story/_/id/22122836/rj-barrett-zion-williamson-lead-mcdonald-all-american-teams |website=ESPN.com |publisher=ESPN |accessdate=August 25, 2018 |date=January 16, 2018}} ===Recruiting=== Smith was ranked among the top 25 prospects of the 2018 recruiting class by [[Rivals.com|Rivals]], [[247Sports.com|247Sports]], and [[ESPN]]. He was also ranked as one of the top prospects at his position by all three scouting services. {{College athlete recruit start|40=no|collapse=no|year=2018}} {{College athlete recruit entry | recruit = Maryland.jpg|thumb|left|Smith playing against Ohio State]] On November 8, 2017, Smith signed his [[National Letter of Intent]] to play for [[Maryland Terrapins men's basketball|Maryland]] after verbally committing in June.{{cite web |last1=Ermann |first1=Jeff |title="Sticks" is on Board with Maryland |url=https://247sports.com/college/maryland/Article/Jalen-Smith-Signs-with-Terps-Maryland-Basketball-Adds-Recruit-on-Signing-Day-110162866/ |website=247sports.com |publisher=247Sports |accessdate=August 25, 2018 |date=November 8, 2017}} He selected Maryland over programs such as [[Villanova Wildcats men's basketball|Villanova]] and [[Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball|Virginia]].{{cite web |last1=Geary |first1=Molly |title=Jalen Smith Is a Crucial Piece for Maryland as the Terps Aim for a Bounce-Back Year |url=https://www.si.com/college-basketball/2018/08/21/maryland-terrapins-recruiting-jalen-smith |website=SI.com |publisher=Sports Illustrated |accessdate=August 25, 2018 |date=August 21, 2018}} As a freshman, he averaged 11.7 points, 6.8 rebounds and 1.2 blocks per game. He had 19 points and 12 rebounds in a 79–77 win over [[Belmont Bruins men's basketball|Belmont]] in the Round of 64 of the NCAA Tournament. In the next game, a 69–67 loss to [[LSU Tigers men's basketball|LSU]], Smith finished with 15 points, eight rebounds and a career-high five blocks.{{cite news |last1=Markus |first1=Don |title=Jalen Smith will return for sophomore year at Maryland for a multitude of reasons — including his education |url=https://www.baltimoresun.com/sports/terps/bs-sp-jalen-smith-maryland-basketball-returns-0406-story.html |accessdate=November 11, 2019 |work=[[Baltimore Sun]] |date=April 8, 2019}} On December 4, 2019, Smith finished with 15 points and a career-high 16 rebounds in a 72–51 win against [[Notre Dame Fighting Irish men's basketball|Notre Dame]].{{cite news |title=Jalen Smith's double-double helps Maryland rout Notre Dame |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401168240 |accessdate=February 14, 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=December 4, 2019}} On |first1=Don |title=Sparked by Jalen Smith and ‘street ball,’ No. 17 Maryland overcomes 15-point deficit to beat Northwestern, 77–66 release|url=https://bigten.org/news/2020/3/9/big-ten-unveils-mens-basketball-postseason-honors-on-btn.aspx|title=Big Ten Unveils Men’s Basketball Postseason Honors on BTN|publisher=[[Big Ten web|url=https://www.foxsports.com/college-basketball/story/top-flyer-dayton-s-obi-toppin-leads-ap-all-american-team-032020|title=Top Flyer: Dayton’s Obi Toppin leads AP All-American News]]|accessdate=March 11, 2020}} He averaged 15.5 points, 10.5 rebounds, and 2.4 blocks per game as a sophomore.{{cite news |last1=Oyefusi |first1=Daniel |title=Maryland’s Jalen Smith named to AP’s All-America men’s basketball team |url=https://www.baltimoresun.com/sports/terps/bs-sp-maryland-smith-ap-all-american-men-basketball-team-20200320-bt4rgdvuifdjnaftu2yt7zppfm-story.html |accessdate=March 21, 2020 |work=[[Baltimore Sun]] |date=March 20, 2020}} After the season, Smith declared for the [[2020 NBA draft]].{{cite news |last1=Phillips |first1=Scott |title=Maryland’s Jalen
